description: This channel focuses on meticulously researched video essays about video game history and the history of firearms as depicted in games and media. While it started with practical weapon guides for Call of Duty, the channel now produces deep-dive documentaries on topics like classic game retrospectives, the evolution of specific game mechanics, and the real-world development of iconic weapons like the Tommy Gun or Bow and Arrow. The videos are known for their high production value, distinctive British narration, and thorough analysis of subjects ranging from the mythical Polybius arcade cabinet to the pixel art in Four-Byte Burger.
